author: blu
body: Debug visualization overlay. Wireframe mesh rendering, AABB boxes, grid planes, axis indicators, and a stats HUD showing frame time, triangle count, and node count. Draws directly to the framebuffer on top of the 3D scene.

author: reek
body: A Vertex holds integer world coordinates and Mat4 is Real, so the projection converts in on the way to clip space and back out to the integer pixel grid. At v4w = 1.0 the w is a true homogeneous coordinate, where the old fixed-point code carried thousandths.
